Definition: from G2285; to stupefy (with surprise), i.e. astound:--amaze, astonish.
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, thambéō means to be amazed, to be astonished. In Mark 1:27, they were all amazed, and it appears again in Mark 10:24. In the Greek text the word is spelled θαμβέομαι.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that amazement at Jesus is the right response, and I want to keep being amazed.
